checks: A closed session is inert; a new tunnel stays open before 1.25 seconds and reaches the map at the threshold, hiding its world VFX.
Invalid/negative deltas cannot corrupt time; exact midpoint and threshold timing work; a very large finite delta clamps to map progress 1.
Exactly three original routes return their link message; unknown, prototype and non-string IDs fail without changing the selected route or map.
Snapshots are detached at every exposed nesting level and remain stable across later state changes; caller edits cannot modify the route catalogue or live session.
The active pulse uses two unshadowed draws, 768 triangles, 28 points and no textures; its opacity stays restrained and the optional camera is unchanged.
Reduced motion hides all world VFX and leaves particle positions still while preserving travel timing; a live preference change does not restart the transition.
Twenty-five open/select/restart/cancel cycles clear stale selection and reuse the same scene objects and geometry.
Disposal before start, during the tunnel and on the map removes only the owned group and releases its instance buffer, two geometries and two materials exactly once; later calls cannot revive it.
Independent sessions do not share selection or lifecycle ownership.
note: Actual source-model and Three.js lifecycle checks; browser rendering, controls and OS preference wiring are separate integration checks.
